dct_description_sm: Coastal Action initiated the LaHave River Watershed Project (LRWP) in 2007, in response to increasing public concern over the health of the river, with a goal of identifying and reducing environmental degradation in the watershed.  Over the years, this project has involved water quality monitoring, habitat assessment and restoration, invasive species research, and community outreach.  The LRWP is guided by an advisory committee comprised of government, academic, industry, non-profit, and citizen representatives and is funded by multiple partners.
